sources.extracted_facts: The official page labels the technology wicktech and the panel reads WICK-TECH. Product pages describe Wicktech as moisture-wicking technology that helps keep sweat away. Flexiknit is a separate OFFLIMITS footwear technology; mesh, Flyknit, KPU, EVA, PU and Phylon/TPR are product specifications.

Women's Printed Insert Tights are mid-rise, 90% polyester/10% spandex and list Wicktech. Snow and Sonic are full-sleeve zip-neck tracksuits in 90% polyester/10% spandex and list Wicktech. WMN PCT CNS is a full-sleeve polyester hooded tracksuit and lists Wicktech.

Gladiator lists a knitted upper with KPU overlay, memory-foam insock and Phylon/TPR sole, with running, gym, errands and travel positioning. Ethos lists a Flyknit upper, super-soft EVA insock, Phylon/TPR sole and grip/slip-resistance language, with gym and cross-training positioning.
Gladiator For Her lists a Flyknit upper, memory-foam insock and Phylon/TPR sole. Pulse X For Her lists a mesh upper, PU-moulded insock and Phylon/TPR sole.

Use the supplied ChatGPT draft as a tone reference. Make OFFLIMITS and its named products the heroes; use technologies and materials as supporting proof points. The desired takeaway is that OFFLIMITS has the right product for the customer's workout.
